market_question: Ukraine agrees not to join NATO before 2027?
reasoning: While Ukraine has consistently rejected permanent neutrality, the market rules count any temporary no-NATO pledge (e.g., a 10‑year moratorium) as a Yes outcome. With Trump’s push for a quick peace deal and Russia’s core demand for Ukrainian neutrality, a ceasefire agreement that includes such a clause appears more likely than the 19% implied price. I estimate a 25% chance that a qualifying pledge is made by the end of 2026.
evidence_points: Multiple leaked peace plans (e.g., Kellogg proposal) include a 20‑year ban on NATO membership
Ukraine’s leadership has hinted at a ‘Finnish model’ when pressed on neutrality
Any temporary pledge, even as a precondition for further talks, would trigger a Yes per the resolution rules
